InvalidBody.description: `invalid_body`: the body failed decoding or validation.

InvalidParameter.description: `invalid_parameter`: a query or header parameter is invalid.

NotFound.description: `not_found`: no such resource in the caller's scope.

PayloadTooLarge.description: `payload_too_large`: the body exceeds the route's limit.

Restricted.description: `account_deletion_pending`: the account is scheduled for deletion and this session is export-only; `password_change_required`: the password was reset and must be changed with `PATCH /me` first.

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized`: missing, invalid, expired or revoked access token (signed out, device removed, account disabled).

AdminUser.description: An account as admins see it: status and dates, never content.

deletion_at.description: When the account will be purged.

export_downloaded_at.description: When the user downloaded their export (admins never see the export itself).

password_change_required.description: The account is on a temporary password.

access_token.description: Bearer token for API calls (EdDSA-signed, short-lived).

export_only.description:
The account is scheduled for deletion: only `GET /me`, `GET /me/export`,
`POST /me/confirm-deletion` and logout work.

password_change_required.description: The password was reset by an admin: change it with `PATCH /me` first.

refresh_token.description: Single-use refresh token; `POST /auth/refresh` returns the next one.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: When the refresh token (and the session) expires.

ControlFrame.description: `reset`: refetch state, then continue after `seq`. `end`: the stream finished.

CreateUser.description: `POST /admin/users` body: an active account, created by an admin.

Device.description: A signed-in device of the caller.

current.description: This is the device making the request.

name.description: Name given at login or by `PATCH`.

reminders_enabled.description: Whether this device schedules local reminder notifications (D27).

DevicePlatform.description: The app platform a device runs on.

DuplicateCandidate.description: An existing item a create request resembles (`409 duplicate_candidates`, §7.5).

device_name.description: Name of this device, shown in the device list (1–100 characters).

deletion_at.description: When a scheduled deletion will be purged.

export_only.description: This session is export-only (account scheduled for deletion).

password_change_required.description: The password was reset by an admin and must be changed with `PATCH /me`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for dates, tasks and reminders (default: the server's).

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem details, encoded as `application/problem+msgpack`. `type` is a problem slug (e.g. `not_found`, `duplicate_candidates`); clients treat unknown slugs by `status`.

candidates.description: `duplicate_candidates`: the existing items the create resembles.

current_version.description: `version_conflict`: the server's current version of the resource.

detail.description: Occurrence-specific explanation. Never contains user content.

title.description: Fixed summary of the problem type.

ProblemFieldError.description: One validation or decoding failure inside a request.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the decoded body, or the parameter name.

SettableStatus.description: Status an admin can set directly.

password.description: At least the configured minimum length.

username.description:
3–32 letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-` (any script); compared case- and
confusable-insensitively.

reminders_enabled.description: Turn local reminder notifications on this device on or off.

UpdateMe.description: `PATCH /me` body: every field is optional; absent fields are unchanged.

new_password.description: New password; requires `current_password`. Other sessions are signed out.

preferences.description: Replaces all preferences (at most 64 entries; keys ≤ 64 bytes, values ≤ 1024).

reset_password.description:
Replace the password with a one-time temporary password (returned once); the user must
change it at next sign-in, and every session ends.

temporary_password.description: The temporary password, present only when `reset_password` was set. Shown once.

info.description: Strata HTTP API. Every body is MessagePack (application/vnd.msgpack); errors are RFC 7807 problem details (application/problem+msgpack). See docs/WIRE_FORMAT.md.
